or_oha_school.name: Oregon School and Child Care Immunization Rates
or_oha_school.location: OHA Annual School Immunization Rate Files (Excel)
or_oha_school.description: Annual school-level immunization coverage data for Oregon K-12 students and preschool/child care children, collected through Oregon's annual school immunization reporting requirement. Schools and child care facilities report vaccination status for all enrolled children each fall. Data cover DTaP/Tdap, Polio, Varicella, MMR, Hepatitis B, Hepatitis A, and (for preschool) Hib vaccines, as well as exemption rates. School-level data are aggregated to the county level using enrollment-weighted counts. The Excel files at the OHA website are updated annually; the URL overwrites the prior year's file each school year.
or_oha_school.restrictions: Public domain. Oregon Health Authority data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

or_alert_iis_ec.name: Oregon ALERT IIS - Early Childhood Immunization Rates
or_alert_iis_ec.location: Oregon Early Childhood Immunization Rates dashboard (Tableau Public)
or_alert_iis_ec.description: Immunization coverage rates for 2-year-old children drawn from Oregon's ALERT IIS (Immunization Information System). ALERT IIS is Oregon's statewide immunization registry, recording vaccinations administered by providers across the state. The dashboard reports the percentage of children who turned 2 years old in the reporting year and are up-to-date on each recommended vaccine. This IIS-based coverage reflects registry completeness and may differ from survey-based estimates such as the NIS. Data are accessed via the Tableau Public CSV export endpoint after establishing a browser session.
or_alert_iis_ec.restrictions: Public domain. Oregon Health Authority data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

or_alert_iis_adol.name: Oregon ALERT IIS - Adolescent Immunization Rates
or_alert_iis_adol.description: Immunization coverage rates for adolescents drawn from Oregon's ALERT IIS (Immunization Information System). The dashboard reports the percentage of adolescents (ages 13-17) who are up-to-date on recommended adolescent vaccines including HPV, meningococcal conjugate (MenACWY), and Tdap. Data are updated annually each May and are accessed via the Tableau Public CSV export endpoint after establishing a browser session.
or_alert_iis_adol.restrictions: Public domain. Oregon Health Authority data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
